Install: `uv tool install miseenplace-cli` (commands: `miseenplace`, `mep`). Try it: `uvx --from miseenplace-cli mep demo`.

`mep` now closes your day for you: what still waits on you, what is already done, what you learned, and how long people wait on you.

## Highlights

- `mep today` shows the day's threads that involve you, awaiting-you first, at about a tenth of the size of `digest`.
- `mep reconcile` checks every open journal item against its thread or PR and proposes `done`, `waiting` or `todo`; `--apply` writes only what changed.
- `mep lessons` keeps lessons as "when X, do Y, not Z" with evidence and votes, and a weekly replay of past corrections restores the last good set if a change makes them worse.
- `mep stats` measures how long people wait on you: reply latency, PR review turnaround and queue, items closed, and how the day felt. `--delta` compares the last week with the two before.
- `mep ask` / `mep asks` queue the assistant's questions and show them as one ranked digest, about two minutes of reading, twice a day.
- A bundled `eod-review` skill ties it together each evening and never messages anyone.

## Try it

```bash
uv tool upgrade miseenplace-cli
mep today
mep reconcile
```

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ankitkpandey1/miseenplace/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
